name: app-trip-summary-with-donation-widget-and-dynamic-island
title: Black-and-white 'You arrived!' screen with lime stats, donation chips and a completed pill
whatItIs: A white board with a centred phone: a black header 'You arrived!', a black stat block with lime distance and total, route rows, donation chips ($1, selected $3, $5) and a lime Done button, flanked by a black donation widget and a black 'You arrived!' pill with a lime check, plus a small explanation text.
whatItMeans: Calm and decisive; two numbers and one button end the trip.
techniques: Show the summary as two big lime numbers.
Offer donation chips instead of ratings.
Show the same state as a widget and island pill.
Explain the logic in a caption.

vocabulary.definition: A screen confirming a task is done.
A short note explaining a choice.
